variants.headline: People leave the colony on the ship
variants.body: People have left the colony on the ship: young adults without work and families without homes. Keep the people behind the story in view, and ask the hard questions without inventing answers.

variants.headline: Departure follows a lack of work and homes
variants.body: The ship has taken away young adults with no work and families with no home. Keep the people behind the story in view, and ask the hard questions without inventing answers.

variants.headline: A ship takes settlers away
variants.body: Young adults lacking work and families lacking homes have departed the colony aboard the ship. Keep the people behind the story in view, and ask the hard questions without inventing answers.
